originals.ko: 너는 그녀가 오늘 뭘 하고 싶다고 느끼는지 들었어?
originals.why: Here mae hi'n means 'she', the sense this course teaches. 'teimlo fel gwneud' is natural North Welsh.

In 'mae hi'n mynd yn hwyr', hi means 'it' (it's getting late), not 'she'. The course taught mae hi'n as 그녀는 ~해, so this is the wrong sense. A Korean prompt that follows the gloss would give 'she is getting late', which is unnatural.
Impersonal hi ('it's getting late') is not the 'she' sense of mae hi'n that this LEGO teaches.
